label: Ordinary severe dehydration from watery diarrhoea

input.complaints: Profuse watery diarrhoea (like rice water) for 12 hours with repeated vomiting. Very weak and sleepy, cannot drink.
input.findings: A cholera outbreak has been declared in his district. Lethargic, eyes sunken, pulse weak and fast, skin pinch goes back very slowly, not able to drink. Blood glucose not yet checked.
